name: HRSA Feed Specialist
failure_modes: rate limit hit before all states processed
notes: 50 states + DC. pageSize=100. 0.5s delay between states. Fails silently on some states — check for empty results not just errors.

name: 211.org Feed Specialist
failure_modes: API key required for some endpoints
notes: 10 search terms. 1s delay between. Schema varies — check for both records and results keys.

name: Eventbrite Feed Specialist
notes: EVENTBRITE_TOKEN env var optional but recommended. Filter status=live. Free events only. 12 search terms.

name: Congress Legislators Feed Specialist
notes: No API key needed. Returns 516 current members. Check both first/last name fields and official_full. Most reliable source we use.

name: RAM Clinic Feed Specialist
notes: Scraper not API. Fragile. Check ramusa.org manually if scanner returns 0 RAM events. Annual Wise VA event is most reliable.

name: Neon Database Specialist
failure_modes: too many connections on free tier
notes: Neon free tier has connection limits. pool_pre_ping catches stale connections. DB URL in seed scripts hardcoded — Render uses env var.

name: Render Deployment Specialist
checks: all required env vars set in Render dashboard
notes: Free tier spins down after inactivity. Scanner must start within 30s of startup. Check Render logs for lifespan errors first.

name: Resend Email Specialist
notes: Free tier: 100 emails/day. FROM_ADDRESS must match verified domain. TEAM_EMAIL falls back to FOUNDER_EMAIL if not set.

name: Resource Scanner Specialist
failure_modes: DB session not closed after scan
notes: Scanner runs as daemon thread. If it crashes the app continues — check logs for [SCANNER] output. Last_updated refresh happens after every scan.

name: Barter System Specialist
failure_modes: SECRET_KEY mismatch between Commons and Gleaning
checks: SECRET_KEY same on both Render services
notes: Coming soon until Commons is ready. Backend complete. JWT verification uses same SECRET_KEY as The Commons HS256.

name: Pawns System Specialist
checks: import json at top of main.py
check both official_full and first+last name fields
notes: 6 detailed manually seeded. 510+ from scanner. Scanner uses unitedstates.github.io — no API key needed.

name: Map System Specialist
notes: Resources page uses dark CARTO tiles. Popup events filter ?popup=1 in API. Z-index managed via JS toggleSidebar function.

name: Authentication Specialist
failure_modes: Commons auth not compatible with Gleaning barter
checks: SECRET_KEY set as permanent env var not generated
SECRET_KEY identical on both Render services
notes: Commons uses python-jose for JWT. Gleaning barter.py uses same library. SECRET_KEY must never rotate without coordinating both services.
